data.description:
## Description

**What**: Hook into the existing worktree-dispatch / worktree-creation helper to write `.kudos/session-id` as part of worktree bootstrap, so every event in the kudos ledger is attributable to a known session from the very first tool call onward.

**Why**: SC-7 explicitly requires the *primary* write path for `.kudos/session-id` to be at worktree creation time. Story b41b-0369 provides only the fail-open generation path (commit-validate.sh creates the file if missing). This story adds the primary path while preserving the fail-open fallback.

**Scope**:
- IN: Worktree-creation entry point identification (worktree-dispatch helper / wrapper script); write `.kudos/session-id` at bootstrap time; preserve the fail-open path from b41b-0369; integration test asserting the file exists with a valid UUID before any commit-validate.sh invocation; second worktree produces a different UUID
- OUT: Changing the UUID format or file path (must match b41b-0369); changing commit-validate.sh fallback behavior; overwriting an existing `.kudos/session-id` (idempotent: only write if absent)

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, worktree creation (via the DSO worktree-dispatch helper or equivalent bootstrap script) writes a UUID to .kudos/session-id before any agent activity in that worktree
  ← Satisfies: sc-7  (sc-7: "Session UUID written at worktree creation")
- When this story is complete, if .kudos/session-id is missing at commit-validate.sh runtime (e.g., manual `git worktree add` bypassing the helper), the existing fail-open path from b41b-0369 still generates a UUID and the ledger does not error
  ← Satisfies: sc-7  (sc-7: "fails-open if absent")
- When this story is complete, an integration test creates a worktree via the DSO helper, asserts .kudos/session-id exists with a valid UUID format before any commit-validate.sh invocation, and confirms a second worktree gets a different UUID
  ← Satisfies: sc-7
- When this story is complete, unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic

## Considerations

- Identify the canonical worktree-creation entry point — likely the worktree-dispatch helper referenced in plugins/dso/skills/shared/prompts/worktree-dispatch.md and wrapper scripts under .claude/scripts/dso
- Use the same UUID generator that commit-validate.sh uses (likely uuidgen or /proc/sys/kernel/random/uuid with a portable fallback) to avoid format drift between primary and fallback paths
- Confirm with b41b-0369 that the file path (.kudos/session-id) and format (raw UUID, no trailing newline assumptions) match exactly
- Idempotent: only write if absent — preserves session identity across re-entry

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: Write session UUID at worktree creation (primary path) with fail-open fallback
